x: There were some fine results all round but at the end of the competition there was still no clear cut winner in the Boys section, Robert Taylor eventually getting the verdict over Matt Cannon by virtue of his greater score in all eight events.

Pat Lyttle showed his class with three wins plus a relay victory and was ably supported by Matt Cannon who gained two wins and a 2nd. This great win set us up for the remaining two league matches and hopefully for promotion to division one next year.
Matt Cannon (14) 2:05.1 The HAC Trophy this year had a special significance for Belgrave.
None more so than Scott Wyld who finished the season with a 1.75m jump to break Matt Cannon's 1978 record of 1.70m. We hear that Scott has been invited to compete in Paris at the end of October.
